objects.name: The Waiting Lantern
objects.description: Its flame bends toward the road, though there is no wind.

objects.name: Road Token
objects.description: A small dark coin marked with a line that never quite ends.
objects.pickupMessage: The token warms in your hand. Somewhere ahead, a light answers.

objects.name: Mile Stone Zero
objects.description: The stone reads: YOU WERE EXPECTED.
